shippingGuidance.title: Shipping Guidance
shippingGuidance.intro: At AfriNuts, we're committed to providing flexible shipping solutions to meet your needs. Currently, we offer two main shipping options with more coming soon.

fob.title: FOB (Free on Board)
fob.description: Buyer takes responsibility for shipping from our port of origin. Ideal for buyers who have preferred shipping partners.

exw.title: EXW (Ex Works)
exw.description: Pick up goods from our warehouse; buyer handles all transport and logistics. Perfect for local buyers or those with established logistics.

cif.title: CIF (Cost, Insurance, and Freight)
cif.description: We handle shipping, insurance, and delivery to your port of destination. We'll handle everything to your destination port.

ddp.title: DDP (Delivered Duty Paid)
ddp.description: Seller takes full responsibility including import duties and taxes, delivered to buyer’s location. Full door-to-door service with all costs included.

other.title: Other / Custom Arrangement
other.description: Some clients may want a specific logistic solution (charter ship, container consolidation, etc.). Tailored solutions for unique requirements.

shippingGuidance.helpText: Need help deciding which option is best for you? Our team is here to guide you through the process.
